caption_fb:
5 Polish phrases for the day you visit the village:

Dzień dobry (jen DOH-bri): Hello / Good morning
Dziękuję (jen-KOO-yeh): Thank you
Przepraszam (psheh-PRAH-shahm): Excuse me / Sorry
Nie mówię po polsku (nyeh MOO-vyeh poh POHL-skoo): I don't speak Polish
Proszę mówić wolniej (PROH-sheh MOO-veech VOHL-nyey): Please speak more slowly

Going Back to Poland has 51 phrases on printable cards for the parish office, the cemetery and the family table.
